**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are curious, collaborative, customer-minded, and motivated by solving real problems for financial professionals, say hello to SimCorp.

At SimCorp, we are guided by our values: caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. We are a people-centered organization that invests in skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in creating an environment where people can grow, feel heard, and be empowered to make an impact.

If this sounds like you, keep reading.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**You will join SimCorp’s Product Division and work on one of our most critical front-office capabilities: Portfolio Management.

Portfolio managers at asset management firms operate under increasing pressure: volatile markets, complex portfolios, tighter risk constraints, and the need to make better investment decisions faster. Static reports and disconnected tools are no longer enough. Portfolio managers need software that helps them understand portfolio positioning, risk usage, exposures, scenarios, and investment intent — and then translate that insight into action.

That is what we are building.

Built on the SimCorp One platform, our modern Portfolio Management solution helps portfolio managers monitor portfolios, analyze exposures and risk, evaluate alternatives, rebalance, and act within coherent, workflow-driven software designed for true front-office use.

This role exists because Portfolio Management is a strategic growth area for SimCorp and our clients. As Product Manager / Product Owner, you will help turn real portfolio manager workflows into intuitive, scalable software. You do not need to come from a traditional product-management background to succeed. You may have gained relevant experience through value advisory, pre-sales, consulting, implementation, client advisory, or another role where you worked closely with investment-management clients and translated their needs into practical solutions.

The common thread is this: you understand client problems, can structure them clearly, and are motivated to shape software that helps portfolio managers work better every day.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**As Product Manager, you will be accountable for execution, learning, and impact — not just producing backlog items.

You will:

• 
Own the product direction and backlog for one or more Portfolio Management capabilities.

• 
Translate portfolio manager needs, client feedback, and market insight into clear, actionable product increments.

• 
Lead and continuously prioritize the backlog for one or more full-stack scrum teams, balancing client value, product quality, platform direction, and technical health.

• 
Work closely with engineers, designers, architects, product peers, and client-facing colleagues to shape workflows, interactions, and data models that make sense in real front-office contexts.

• 
Build a strong understanding of portfolio manager workflows, including:

• 
Portfolio monitoring and decision preparation

• 
Exposure and risk analysis

• 
Scenario evaluation and rebalancing

• 
Order generation and execution workflows

• 
Write clear product briefs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and decision material focused on user intent and business outcomes.

• 
Use client feedback, internal expertise, usage insight, and delivery learning to validate priorities and iterate quickly.

• 
Collaborate with other Product Owners and Product Managers to ensure coherent front-office workflows across Portfolio Management and adjacent product areas.

• 
Support demos, discovery conversations, and client discussions by grounding the conversation in real portfolio manager use cases.

• 
Act as a consistent voice of the portfolio manager in product, design, and delivery decisions.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with strong ownership, visibility, and direct impact.

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself thriving in the role described above. How you acquired the skills matters less than how you apply them.

You may be a strong fit if you have several of the following:

• Experience working with asset managers, investment teams, front-office users, or investment-management technology.

• A background in one or more of the following areas:

• Product management or product ownership

• Value advisory or solution advisory

• Pre-sales or solution consulting

• Business consulting or implementation consulting

• Client advisory, customer success, or professional services in financial technology

• Ability to understand complex client workflows and translate them into clear product needs, priorities, and delivery outcomes.

• Familiarity with portfolio management, portfolio construction, rebalancing, exposure/risk analysis, or order-generation workflows.

• Comfort working with analytics, data, and financial concepts.

• Some knowledge of SimCorp Dimension is clearly a plus, especially if you have worked with front-office, portfolio management, or investment workflows.

Ways of working

• Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Ability to structure ambiguous problems and turn them into practical next steps.

• Curiosity about users, workflows, and the “why” behind product decisions.

• Pragmatic, outcome-oriented mindset.

• Ability to zoom out to understand portfolio manager goals — and zoom in to refine workflows, interactions, and details.

• Confidence working with engineers, designers, product peers, and client-facing colleagues.

• Willingness to learn product-management practices if your background is advisory, consulting, or pre-sales.

As a person, you:

• Collaborate naturally with colleagues across disciplines.

• Are comfortable questioning assumptions and navigating complexity.

• Communicate clearly and speak up when needed.

• Balance structure with creativity.

• Care deeply about usability — not just functional completeness.

• Are motivated by creating software that solves real client problems.

**Benefits

**Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. At SimCorp, we believe we can offer more.

In addition to traditional benefits, we provide excellent work-life balance, flexible working hours, and a hybrid workplace model. We also have innovation and personal-development sprints, giving you dedicated time each quarter to master your skills and contribute to company development. There is never only one route — we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible. We process incoming applications continuously. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in recruitment. To support fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or other non-professional information from your application. Thank you for helping us mitigate bias in the recruitment process.

If you are interested in being part of SimCorp but are not sure whether this role is suitable, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may bring relevant skills from product, advisory, pre-sales, consulting, implementation, or client-facing financial-technology roles. Our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help assess whether this is the right opportunity for you.

We are continually improving our talent-acq

uisition process and aim to make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. During the process, we may ask you to provide feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become a leading provider of integrated investment-management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of Deutsche Börse Group. Following the merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law.

We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

SYBO is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

_Some games chase trends. Subway Surfers helped define an entire genre.

_Now, we're looking for a UI/UX Designer to help shape what comes next.

This is your chance to leave your mark on one of the biggest mobile games ever made. A game with a massive global audience, instant player feedback, and a team that never settles for "good enough". The challenge? Keeping an iconic game feeling fresh, modern, and innovative for hundreds of millions of players around the world.

Come help evolve the visual experience of Subway Surfers, designing new features, game modes, and player journeys while continuously improving the experience that keeps players coming back. Some days you'll be crafting entirely new interfaces. Other days you'll make a tiny change that unlocks a surprisingly big impact. That's the fun part.

If you enjoy solving creative puzzles, have a knack for details, and seeing your work reach millions of players, then this might just be your gig.

**Responsibilities

**

• Actively refine and improve existing UI/UX to elevate player engagement and satisfaction, ensuring Subway Surfers remains intuitive, modern, and enjoyable to play.

• Design and implement intuitive, engaging UI screens, assets, and interactions for new and existing features.

• Create UX wireframes, user flows, and prototypes to support feature development and player experiences.

• Help shape the visual direction of the game's interface, evolving and modernizing the experience, while staying true to the Subway Surfers brand.

• Ensure a consistent visual style, tone, and user experience across all UI elements.

• Create and maintain UI documentation, design systems, and style guides to support consistency and scalability.

• Optimize UI implementations to ensure smooth performance across a wide range of mobile devices.

Life at SYBO

**In your first month...

**You'll get to know the team, the game, and the players that have made Subway Surfers one of the most successful mobile games in the world. You'll be introduced to our tools, workflows, and ways of working while building relationships across the studio. With support from your teammates, you'll begin contributing to your first projects and quickly find your footing as part of the team.

**Within 3 months...

**You'll start taking ownership of more impactful work across the game, designing engaging interfaces and helping improve the player experience through thoughtful UI/UX solutions. You'll collaborate closely with the team to iterate on designs based on player feedback, insights, and performance data.

**By 12 months...

**You'll be a trusted contributor to the future of Subway Surfers, able to lead individual UI/UX initiatives across major features. At this point, your contributions to the UI style guide and visual framework will have enabled a smoother collaboration across teams, ensuring Subway Surfers will remain an evergreen.

**Requirements

**

• A strong portfolio demonstrating solid UI design work for games, with clear examples of creating intuitive, polished, and engaging player experiences.

• Strong ability to create wireframes, user flows, mockups, and polished final designs that effectively balance player needs and business goals.

• Skilled at designing, rendering, and animating high-quality UI elements that bring personality and clarity to the player experience.

• Advanced proficiency with modern UI/UX and prototyping tools, particularly Figma.

• Experience working with Unity and a solid understanding of UI implementation

Bonus Points

• Knowledge of conducting user research and translating player insights into actionable design improvements.

• Experience working on large-scale live service mobile games.

**About SYBO

**We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4.5 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

If you join us, you'll have the opportunity to dive into exciting and creative projects alongside a diverse group of like-minded colleagues from over 40 countries across the globe.

We truly believe you perform your best, when you have the equipment you need - and our IT team is always on hand to ensure you have access to the latest tools and gear, enabling you to be at your best - even remotely with a home-office budget!

We also pride ourselves in taking care of your well-being, offering a delicious lunch buffet, a variety of healthy snacks, and regular social events to keep the energy flowing.

Not in Copenhagen? Not a problem! We have in-house relocation specialists who will help you relocate, and feel right at home in Copenhagen and at SYBO!

SYBO is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About The Job

**Excited to make a real impact while diving into the finance world? Are you passionate about turning data into actionable insights? As a BI Business Analyst, you will play a key role in empowering colleagues with business intelligence and driving data-driven decision-making across the organization.

This is more than just a job - it is an opportunity to develop valuable skills within BI and finance, collaborate across teams, and contribute to impactful projects within life sciences, renewable energy, and fundamental research.

We are involved in projects that will transform the way we live. With more than fifteen years of expertise and innovation, Hamamatsu Photonics strives to remain the market leader in everything we do.

**Responsibilities

**As a BI Business Analyst, you will be transforming numbers into insights by working intensively within Power BI and Snowflake. You will play a key role in transforming the organization into a data-driven company creating value through insights.

• Act as the go-to person for BI support of new insights and issue resolution

• Transform raw data into meaningful insights using Power BI and Snowflake

• Gather and prioritize requirements from finance and stakeholders

• Develop and maintain dashboards with intuitive visualizations

• Improve and modernize Power BI solutions

• Automate manual finance processes

• Ensure data models support business needs

• Collaborate closely with IT and business teams

• Manage tickets and resolve data issues

• Stay up to date with Power BI and data storytelling best practices

In you, we hope to find

• Strong experience with Power BI and Snowflake

• Strong ability to define and implement KPIs that measure and drive performance across key business drivers

• Experience with D365 is an advantage

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to translate data into insights

• Experience with financial datasets

• Strong communication skills in English

You are a proactive and hands-on team player who thrives in a collaborative environment, balancing business understanding with strong technical execution.

Our culture is positive, pragmatic, and focused on delivering both quick wins and long-term value. We collaborate closely across the BI team, Finance, and the wider organization to translate data and insights into tangible business impact. Within the BI team, we cover both frontend development in Power BI and backend development in dbt/Snowflake, working in close partnership with our colleagues in IT to ensure structured, reliable data from source systems.

Because collaboration is central to how we work, we primarily work from the office.

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

Support a 9-year-old boy in Skævinge

Jobbeskrivelse

Do you have experience working with children with special needs, and do you enjoy an active one-to-one role? Then you could become an important source of support for a 9-year-old boy who loves movement, play and safe, predictable routines.

About the role

You will provide regular one-to-one support for a 9-year-old boy with autism and an intellectual disability. He needs close support, clear structure and a calm approach that helps create predictability.

The boy is energetic, enjoys being active and particularly likes outdoor play, trips to the playground and running in the woods. He also enjoys activities such as puzzles, music, bubbles, balloons and sensory toys. Your role is to plan and take part in activities that match his pace and needs. As he has limited awareness of danger, it is important that you stay close to him and remain attentive to his surroundings.

The role includes assistance with personal care, including bathing, changing diapers and toilet training. You will also provide support at mealtimes, with a focus on motivating and guiding him towards gradually becoming more independent.

The boy does not communicate verbally and uses only a few English words. It is therefore important that you are able to communicate in English, including with his parents, who do not speak Danish.

The boy has food allergies and has an EpiPen, which must be used in the event of an allergic reaction. The family will provide thorough instructions on its use. He also has asthma, and his parents are responsible for all medication management.

About you

You may be a qualified pedagogue/social educator or have relevant experience working with children with special needs. You approach the child with calmness, patience and clarity, and you enjoy an active working environment where you take part in play and physical activities.

At the same time, you are able to create structure and a sense of security, be attentive and provide clear boundaries when needed. As communication with the family takes place in English, you must be able to communicate confidently in English.

A driving licence is an advantage. Alternatively, you must be comfortable using the family’s cargo bike, which will be provided.

Working hours

The position is for 16 hours per week. The working hours are:

Two weekdays per week: 3 hours after school, from 2:30 pm to 5:30 pm

Thursdays: 9:30 am to 1:30 pm (4 hours)

Sundays: 11:00 am to 5:00 pm

What we offer

You will become part of a family-owned company with many dedicated employees. You will have a dedicated adviser who is available for guidance and support. Outside office hours, a staffed emergency phone line is always available, so you are never on your own.

Salary and pension are provided in accordance with the national collective agreement between FOA and the Danish Chamber of Commerce (Dansk Erhverv). You are covered by DUOS’ liability and occupational injury insurance, and health insurance is included as part of your pension scheme.

We offer a wide range of courses, and as a DUOS employee, you will receive relevant induction and ongoing professional development. Working with people at DUOS also gives you the opportunity to develop both personally and professionally.

Would you like to become our new colleague?

Please submit your application via the link. You must have a profile on mit.duos.dk and be logged in to apply. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. The position is available for an immediate start.

If you have any further questions, please contact Recruitment Consultant Trine Ankær Johansen on +45 36 34 49 90. You can also find answers to general questions in our FAQ.

We are people helping people

At DUOS, we help people in their everyday lives, support them through challenging situations and contribute to their well-being and quality of life. As one of Denmark’s largest and longest-established welfare service providers, we strive to be there where support is needed.

We understand the importance of combining empathy with the right professional expertise, and we know that finding the right match between an employee and the person receiving support is essential for our services to make a meaningful difference.

Join the DUOS team and make an important difference in another person’s life.

Learn more about DUOS at www.duos.dk.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**About The Role

**Genmab is seeking a Project Manager CMC Product Lifecycle Management to

• join the CMC Life Cycle Management (LCM) Team and support our growing portfolio of commercial products globally.

The LCM team is responsible for managing the CMC lifecycle activities of Genmab’s commercial products and manufacturing oversight, ensuring supply continuity, regulatory compliance, and successful execution of post-approval activities throughout the product lifecycle. In this role, you’ll work closely with LCM Product Lead and colleagues across Commercial Supply Chain, MSAT, Regulatory CMC, Commercial QA and External Manufacturing to ensure seamless execution of lifecycle management activities.

The CMC Life Cycle Management Team is part of CMC Project & Portfolio Management (PPM) which also includes the Early-Stage Development, Late-stage Development and External Manufacturing teams. CMC Project & Portfolio Management resides within CMC Development and Manufacturing, based in Denmark.

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the continued growth of Genmab's commercial portfolio while working in a highly collaborative and cross-functional environment at the interface of development, manufacturing, supply, and regulatory affairs.

**Responsibilities

**

• Work alongside the LCM Lead to provide manufacturing oversight and execute lifecycle activities for an assigned manufacturing track (DS, BI, CI or DP) after commercial launch, supporting batch release and reliable supply. The LCM Lead retains overall product accountability.

• Lead operational governance with internal functions and partners/CMOs, aligning priorities, preparing decisions, tracking progress and actions, and providing input on CMO performance.

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders on daily operations to ensure manufacturing oversight (ie. Deviation management, change control, complaint handling, etc) , support batch release and supply, issues resolution/escalation and quality/regulatory compliance.

• Coordinate technical issue resolution and manage track risks with relevant experts, ensuring required assessments, documentation and mitigation actions, and escalating issues with proposed next steps.

• Drive manufacturing changes, projects and improvements within agreed scope, timelines and budgets.

• Support implementation of CMC commitments and Post-approval change management related to assigned product manufacturing track (i.e DS, BI, CI, DP) and support coordination of submission documentation preparation across stakeholders and CMOs/Partners.

• Support initiatives to optimize yield, reduce cost of goods, and enhance robustness of manufacturing and testing processes

• Help establish and improve LCM processes, governance, tools and ways of working, incorporating lessons learned.

**Requirements

**

• Master's degree in science or related technical discipline (e.g. engineering, biotech, pharmaceutical, biochemistry, biology) or equivalent experience;

• 4+ years of experience in biopharmaceutical industry, preferably within manufacturing operations, lifecycle, product management for commercial products.

• Experience in building relations and influencing multi-functional teams within multicultural organizations.

• Proven track record in CMC project management, manufacturing operations management or product management across development and commercialization activities.

• Experience managing and defining project coordination activities and tasks in a structured, regulated environment.

• Prior experience with commercial product lifecycle management and oversight of Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) is considered an advantage.

• Broad understanding of global cGMP requirements and regulatory expectations across major markets

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in English

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional and multicultural environments

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, balance competing demands, and deliver against project timelines

• Team player with the ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

• Result- and goal-oriented, committed to contributing to Genmab’s success

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK597.312,00---895.968,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for an AI Business Manager to join our Digital Development team.

Team

The AI team is a cross-functional team dedicated to embedding AI directly into CIP's business lifecycles and day-to-day operations across the platform and sits within the wider Digital Development team.

Role

The AI Business Manager is responsible for ensuring AI creates measurable business value across CIP's business lifecycles and works directly with lifecycle owners, product teams, delivery teams, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, drive adoption, and embed AI capabilities into day-to-day processes and ways of working.

The AI Business Manager serves as the bridge between business priorities and AI capabilities, ensuring that AI is integrated directly into the Investor, Investment, Fund & Investment Management, and Project lifecycles rather than delivered as standalone technology initiatives. The role is accountable for helping lifecycle teams identify where AI can accelerate outcomes, improve decision-making, increase productivity, and enhance user experiences while ensuring appropriate governance and value realization.

Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

Lifecycle Partnership and Business Engagement

• Partner with lifecycle owners and business stakeholders to understand priorities and strategic objectives, identifying where AI can improve outcomes, efficiency, and decision quality.

• Participate in lifecycle planning and roadmap discussions to embed AI initiatives into business plans from the outset, acting as the primary AI partner for assigned lifecycle domains.

AI Opportunity and Use Case Management

• Facilitate identification, assessment, and prioritization of AI use cases, maintaining the opportunity pipeline based on business value, feasibility, and strategic alignment.

• Develop business cases, value hypotheses, and success metrics, supporting initiatives from ideation and validation through deployment and value realization.

Embedding AI into Business Lifecycles

• Work with business and technology teams to integrate AI into core processes, products, and workflows, redesigning ways of working where relevant and driving adoption of AI-powered tools.

• Support the evolution of lifecycle operating models to treat AI as a native capability, scaling effective patterns across domains.

Governance and Responsible AI

• Ensure AI initiatives comply with governance, security, risk, privacy, and regulatory requirements, coordinating with legal, risk, compliance, and information security stakeholders as needed.

• Support lifecycle teams in navigating AI policies and approval processes, promoting responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight.

Value Realization and Performance Management

• Track KPIs for AI adoption, utilization, and business value, measuring realized benefits such as productivity gains, cost savings, and risk reduction.

• Provide regular updates to leadership on AI portfolio performance and lifecycle impact.

Change, Communication, and Enablement

• Manage efforts for stakeholder engagement, communications, and change management for AI initiatives, supporting training and capability-building across lifecycle teams.

• Build and maintain networks of AI champions and subject matter experts, promoting a culture of experimentation and responsible AI usage.

You

You have a relevant educational background within business, data science, technology, or a similar field. In addition, you have a good understanding of business processes, operating models, and digital transformation, and 5+ years of experience working with technology transformation, AI, data, automation, or similar initiatives, with the ability to translate business challenges into practical AI opportunities and outcomes.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• Good stakeholder management and communication skills, comfortable translating between business and technology audiences to turn emerging AI capabilities into practical business value.

• Experience driving change, adoption, and organizational enablement initiatives.

• Ability to manage multiple initiatives and priorities in a dynamic environment.

• Curious, business-oriented, and outcome-focused.

• Combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and is motivated by delivering measurable impact through technology-enabled change.

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

CIP Fund Solutions

CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.

ISS seeks to BE a place of belonging and CREATE places where every person is welcomed, embraced, and valued for exactly who they are. Places where people feel safe, respected, represented, and supported as their authentic selves.

As a global leader in facilities services we connect people and places to make the world work better. Whether directly or indirectly, you’ll play a vital role in supporting our placemakers in delivering exceptional workplace experiences for our customers. Together, we make space for people and businesses to thrive.

Location: Copenhagen, DK

Language: English

Main purpose of the position:

As Sales Operations Specialist, you will be driving the implementation and anchoring of the global initiatives in our core sales function and will transform our global commercial approach into world class, standardized, focused and proactive. You will also support countries deploying the tools, processes and platforms to drive an efficient sales execution strategy.

What you’ll do:

• Anchor ‘ISS Way of Selling’, a standardized global set of sales processes that provides an efficient commercial ecosystem and frames the sales execution process

• Drive adoption of the ISS Sales Process, enabling transparent, data-driven, and proactive interactions between our sales teams and our customers, enforcing a customer driven approach

• Support the Commercial Capabilities Development processes going across onboarding, competencies development and Commercial Academy

• Implement and drive the continuous improvement of the already launched tools, systems and processes required to build effective sales teams in countries and globally

• Drive continuous adoption, usage, and development of our CRM platform in close coordination with the sales & commercial managers to drive viability and insights derived from our CRM platform and to enable enhanced sales performance

• Constantly scanning the ISS global commercial team for best-in-class tools, recommend standardization and adoption through bringing the best of ISS to be shared across the global organization

Who you’ll work with:

• Global and countries commercial team (across all roles)

Key qualifications:

• Solid sales experience - has held positions within sales, account management and/or sales operations in a global B2B environment (3+ years)

• Proven track record of driving improvement projects and initiatives beyond scope of initial role

• Experience in working within matrix organizations, with high cross functional collaboration abilities

• Project management capabilities, able to orchestrate the timely delivery of outcomes – possibly for different projects simultaneously

• Be analytical and structured.

Personal skills you excel:

• Be an excellent communicator, able to engage stakeholders at different levels and with different cultures

• Ability to maintain professionalism always under stressful situations

Why ISS

jobs.description:
The National Center of Excellence PREDICT at Aalborg University in Copenhagen is looking to recruit a motivated and dedicated biostatistician with an interest in the technical part of research to join our international and interdisciplinary group of researchers in a double role as biostatistician and technical contact person. The position is for 3 years, full-time (37 hours per week) and is open for appointment from March 1st 2027.

Your work tasks

As biostatistician in PREDICT you will be involved in epidemiological studies of risk factors for IBD, pre-clinical disease development and treatment of IBD. You will join an active group of dedicated biostatisticians and data scientists ensuring knowledge sharing and continuous professional development.

You will contribute to study planning, take responsibility for data management and statistical analyses of nationwide register data and large datasets collected in PREDICT, and contribute to the interpretation and reporting of the results, including co-authoring of scientific papers.

In addition to the biostatistical task, the position also includes the role of the primary technical contact person on our data infrastructure hosted on the National Genom Center’s HPC system. You will coordinate technical support, manage user access and onboarding, and assist researchers with data management, troubleshooting, and computational workflows. The role also involves ensuring secure handling of research data and contributing to the development and optimization of technical workflows.

Your competencies

Ideally, you have the following qualifications:

•    A master’s degree in statistics or equivalent

•    Experience conducting statistical analyses in epidemiological research

•    Knowledge about time-to-event analysis and related statistical methods.

•    Strong programming skills in R and/or Python

•    Experience in working with Linux-based computing environments

•    Experience working on High Performance Computing (HPC) systems

•    Experience with shell scripting for workflow automation and troubleshooting

•    Strong problem-solving skills and ability to support colleagues with technical challenges

•    Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Note that you must be qualified for both parts of the position to be taken into consideration.

Who we are

PREDICT was founded in 2021 and is at the forefront of international research to unravel the cause and prognosis of inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD), which are chronic and disabling conditions affecting millions of people worldwide. The Center is composed of biologists, clinicians, epidemiologists, and data scientists working with collaborators nationally and internationally to push the boundaries of precision medicine research and create real-world impact in IBD. We have state-of-the-art facilities within the center and this means through PREDICT you will be part of a well-funded research environment equipped with the latest technologies, unique data, and a world-leading network of collaborators.

PREDICT has grown to become a world-renowned center, organized as a broad, national and interdisciplinary collaboration between Aalborg University and Aalborg University Hospital, with a multidisciplinary team of immunologists, geneticists, data scientists, clinicians and many more disciplines. PREDICT also has strong international collaborations across the world.

You can read more about PREDICT here: www.predictibd.dk

About the Department of Clinical Medicine

The Department of Clinical Medicine provides research-based teaching across all disciplines of the

medical degree programme and conducts research within the clinical specialties.

Read more about the Department of Clinical Medicine here

How to apply

Your application must contain the following:

• A brief motivated application describing your professional and personal competences and the experience qualifying you particularly for the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Examination certificate

• Any other relevant appendices

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Chief Statistician, Group Leader Gry J. Poulsen, gryjp@dcm.aau.dk

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

**

Salary and terms of employment

Classification is based on competence, experience and seniority, with the possibility of negotiating qualification-based supplements.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Technical and administrative positions Academic (AC-TAP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the sections entitled “Academic Officer” and “Special consultant”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.
